review_improvement: Makes OAM_0 identity, canonical path and exhaustive synchronized field parity explicit instead of accepting an insecure JSON dump.
independent_technical_reasoning: OAM modules can share schema and similar values, so the resource/member identity must be carried into every compared field. Web caching can also make a true source change look inconsistent. Binding module identity and timestamps to raw/normalized/expected values prevents both cross-module and stale-display false conclusions.
